pages.text: Tools created using the Philosopher's Stone and Origin.
A weapon that can be created with the Origin of Courage. $(br)When you take damage while holding it, you receive a buff and can perform a ranged attack that deals special, definite damage.
A pickaxe that can be created with the Origin of Hope. $(br)Right-click to remove a bedrock, shift+right-click to place a bedrock.
Fuel that can be created with the Origin of Love.  $(br)It literally burns forever.
